title: Pointed etale algebras form a filtered category
statement: Let R be a commutative local ring and K a chosen separable closure of its residue field. The full subcategory of Over(CommAlgCat.of R K) consisting of etale R-algebras is filtered.

proof.text: The identity R-algebra equipped with the structural map to K is an object, so the category is nonempty.

For two pointed etale R-algebras S and T, form their pushout over R in CommAlgCat R. The structural maps to K agree on R, so the pushout universal property gives its pointing. Base change followed by composition makes this pushout etale over R, and its inclusions are pointed maps from S and T.

For parallel pointed maps f,g:S to T, let E be their pushout T tensor_S T and let D be T tensor_R T. There are maps m:D to E from the two inclusions, and d:D to T from the identity on both factors. Form U as the pushout of m and d. Maps between etale R-algebras are etale: hence the inclusion T to E, the multiplication d, the base change E to U, and their composites show that U is etale over R. The equalities of the pointings after f and g give E to K; the maps E to K and T to K agree on D and therefore give U to K.

Write l,r:T to E for its two inclusions, k:E to U, and h:T to U for the final inclusion. The pushout equations give l followed by k = h and r followed by k = h. Since f followed by l = g followed by r, composition with k gives f followed by h = g followed by h. The map h respects the pointing by the last pushout equation. These constructions provide the three fields of IsFiltered; morphism extensionality lifts the ring-algebra equality to the full subcategory.

lean.statement:
theorem pointedEtale_filtered
    (R K : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K] [Algebra R K]
    [IsScalarTower R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K] :
    let P : ObjectProperty (Over (CommAlgCat.of R K)) := fun X ↦ Etale R X.left
    IsFiltered P.FullSubcategory
